```{r, function to quantify one sample}

quantify <- function(sample_file, output, salmon, index,
                     threads = 8,
                     validate = TRUE,
                     fldMean = NULL, fldSD = NULL,
                     extra = character(),
                     doit = TRUE) {

  stopifnot(file.exists(sample_file))
  stopifnot(dir.exists(index) || file.exists(index))  # salmon index is a directory
  stopifnot(file.exists(salmon))

  sample <- basename(sample_file)
  # strip .gz then .fastq/.fq
  sample <- sub("\\.gz$", "", sample, ignore.case = TRUE)
  sample <- sub("\\.(fastq|fq)$", "", sample, ignore.case = TRUE)

  out_dir <- file.path(output, paste0(sample, "_quant"))
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  args <- c(
    "quant",
    "-i", index,
    "-l", "A",
    "-r", sample_file,
    "-p", as.integer(threads),
    "-o", out_dir
  )

  if (isTRUE(validate)) args <- c(args, "--validateMappings")
  if (!is.null(fldMean)) args <- c(args, "--fldMean", as.numeric(fldMean))
  if (!is.null(fldSD))   args <- c(args, "--fldSD",   as.numeric(fldSD))
  if (length(extra))     args <- c(args, extra)

  if (doit) {
    system2(salmon, args)
  } else {
    message(paste(shQuote(salmon), paste(shQuote(args), collapse = " ")))
    invisible(0)
  }
}


```

```{r, quantify all samples in a folder using above function}
parent.folder <- DATA

# List FASTQ files directly inside DATA (single-end)
files <- list.files(parent.folder, pattern = "\\.(fastq|fq)(\\.gz)?$", full.names = TRUE)

index  <- INDEX
output <- file.path(DATA_FOLDER, "quants")
dir.create(output, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Run (example: first 2 only; remove [1:2] to run all)
for (sample_file in files[1:2]) {

  quantify(
    sample_file = sample_file,
    output = output,
    salmon = SALMON,
    index = index,
    threads = 8,
    validate = TRUE,
    doit = TRUE
  )

  cat(paste0("Finished running sample: ", basename(sample_file), "\n"))
}

cat("DONE!\n")

```







```{r, function to quantify one sample}
#### adjusted scripts for older data from Denis ####
quantify = function(sample_file, output, salmon, doit = TRUE) {
    sample = basename(sample_file)
    samples = paste0(file.path(sub.folders[x]),"/",sample_file)
    output = file.path(output, paste0(sample, "_quant"))
    args = c(
        "quant", "-i", index, "-l A",
        "-r", samples,
        "-p", parallel::detectCores(),
        "-o", output
    )
    if (doit)
        system2(salmon, args)
    else {
        txt = paste(salmon, paste(args, collapse=" "))
        message(txt)
        invisible(0)
    }
}
```

```{r, quantify all samples in a folder using above function}
# index location
parent.folder <- DATA
sub.folders <- list.dirs(parent.folder, recursive=TRUE)[-1]

# Run scripts in sub-folders 
for (x in seq(sub.folders)){
  sub.files <- list.files(sub.folders[x])
for(i in seq(sub.files)) {
  index=INDEX
  output= file.path(DATA_FOLDER, "quants")
  data_dir = file.path(sub.files[i])
  sample_file = sub.files[i]
  args = list(salmon = SALMON, output = output, doit = T)
  Map(quantify, sample_file, MoreArgs = args)
  cat(paste0("Finished running sample: ",i))
}
}
cat("DONE!")
```
